response.rationale: Both answers are valid for “renewal” in the stated administrative sense. Indonesian perpanjangan denotes extending validity, while Malaysian Malay pembaharuan is an established equivalent for renewal of licences, certificates, agreements, and similar items. The forms are distinct common preferences, not false friends; no contrast is required.
